entries.english:
Criminal cases.

Date range: 1516, 1551–1609, 1625–1633

Contents:
1. Folios 2–33: Brawl between the innkeeper Marx Freundt of Sachsenflur and Endres Odenwald of Dainbach; insult of Pastor Johann Knapp of Unterschüpf by Freundt, 1633.
2. Folios 34–42: Brawl between Albrecht von Dienheim of Unterschüpf and subjects of the Rosenberg family at Oberschüpf, 1591.
3. Folios 43–58: Brawl between Hans Kleinschroth of Pfahlenheim and Ludwig Holch of Waldmannshofen near Ochsenfurt, 1608–1609.
4. Folios 60–68: Infanticide by Dorothea Berner of Oberschüpf, [1600].
5. Folios 69–85, 89: Killing of Barthel Volck of Dainbach by soldiers, 1630.
6. Folios 86–88, 90–93: Killing of the mercenary Simon Eck by inhabitants of Gnötzheim after a theft, 1584.
7. Folios 95–124: Thefts by Simon Prümer of Niederstetten, (1561–1562) 1570–1571.
8. Folios 125–169: Alleged theft of Hans Kübner’s daughter at the house of Margarete Schul of Creglingen; Kübner’s defamation suit, 1569–1574.
9. Folios 170–234: Arrest of the rope-maker Hans Pfister of Mergentheim for attempted illicit intercourse with the wife of Wolf Beier of Sachsenflur, 1584–1585.
10. Folios 235–254: Adultery by the reeve Bastian Hoheneck of Buch am Ahorn, 1593.
11. Folios 255–310: Sorcery and witchcraft by Hans Ritter of Gnötzheim; his wife’s release after she swore an oath of non-hostility, 1590–1592.
12. Folios 311–320: Punishment of Georg Ruck of Oberschüpf for insulting the Schieder family, 1596.
13. Folios 322–329: Theft by Paul Zenner of Uiffingen, 1593.
14. Folios 330–335: Adultery by Martin Steupp, 1625.
15. Folios 336–337: Witchcraft and illicit intercourse by the widow Apollonia Schmied of Unterschüpf, 1506.
16. Folio 338: Embezzlement by the reeve Melchior Wammesser of Epplingen, 1603.
17. Folio 339: Fraud by the tailor Michael Pfister of Epplingen, 1603.
18. Folios 340–345: Mutual insults between Leonhard Völcker of Neubronn and Michael Kurtz of Schmerbach, 1589.
19. Folios 346–349: Thefts by Andreas Renck of Ippesheim, who was arrested in Unterschüpf, 1589.
20. Folios 350–351: Wounding of inhabitants of Unterschüpf by Heinrich Ebeldt, undated.
21. Folios 353–363: Thefts by Leonhard Braun of Belsenberg and Hans Scheffer of Lengfurt, 1602.
22. Folios 364–369: Thefts by Georg Schlummer of Jagsthausen, who was arrested in Uffenheim, 1609.
23. Folios 370–371: Sorcery by the son of Contz Krantz of Sachsenflur, 1602.
24. Folios 372–383: Witchcraft by Barbara Schuepart of Gnötzheim, 1591.
25. Folio 384: Homicide by Hans Meckeßer’s son of Uiffingen against his mentally impaired aunt, 1601.
26. Folio 386: Killing of Stefan Marckart by Valtin Gerlinger, both of Wermutshausen, 1551.
27. Folio 387: Correspondence concerning criminal cases, 1577–1582, 1594–1609.
28. Folios 404–448: Oaths of non-hostility: a) Valentin Roder, 1516; b) Valentin Breuner, reeve of Enheim (failure to prosecute Philipp Stezel, an enemy of Zaisolf von Rosenberg), 1556; c) Linhardt Landtmann of Gülchsheim (tithe fraud), 1556; d) Hans Kall of Waldmannshofen (disobedience), 1558; e) Michel Wunder of Sechselbach (disobedience), 1558; f) Hans Holler of Obernbreit (crayfish theft), 1558; g) Kaspar Wunner of Crailsheim and Hieronymus Schnerrer of Niederstetten (brawl), 1560; h) Hans Cratwol, 1564; i) Georg Höppel of Unterickelsheim (disobedience), 1560; k) Michael Kurtz of Schmerbach, 1590; l) Margarete Weyd of Gnötzheim (witchcraft), 1591; m) Margarete Retz (witchcraft), 1592; n) Fritz Lainbach of Kupprichshausen (thefts), 1603.

Extent: 1 volume, folios 1–448
